narrative.text: Partial development draft for Atlas, a synthetic lead-generation and booking business (brief.md:3-8). Fixed assessment at 2026-11-19T12:00:00Z. Evidence window begins 11:00 UTC inclusive and ends 12:00 UTC exclusive. Maximum capture age is 3600 seconds. One website entity and one captured URL were supplied. /booking appears only as a declared target. Zero pages were fully audited. Site inventory and discovery completeness remain unknown. No live collection or provider measurements were performed.

The 11:30 UTC capture was 1800 seconds old at assessment and supplies complete canonical projections for source head, rendered head and HTTP Link. Observed target format passed the scoped evaluator. Consistency failed. Owner intent, provider-selected canonical and index status are unknown. The cause of the disagreement is unverified.

The supplied synthetic attempt attempt-one used collector version synthetic-export-1 on https://atlas.example/services for atlas-demo / website, mobile, anonymous. It began at 2026-11-19T11:35:00Z and ended at 2026-11-19T11:36:00Z with status unknown and gap browser-unavailable (collection-attempt.json:2-21). Execution authentication and semantic acceptance were both false. The attempt yielded no capture and leaves acquisition availability unknown. The separately supplied 11:30 capture remains usable within its scope.

Page bodies, full inventory and native page evidence were unavailable. Content quality, on-page SEO beyond the scoped canonical checks, AI search optimization, answer quality, generative visibility, crawl and index controls, structured data, measurement, tracking, consent, performance, accessibility and lead/booking journey behavior remain unassessed. No production or independent acceptance is established.

Website engineering should provide the original response/source HTML, final HTTP Link headers and rendered head from a separately authorized capture of /services for the same mobile/anonymous state, with exact UTC time, environment, tool/version and layer completeness. Use a fresh target/window for a later retry. Include direct target controls for /booking if evaluating its eligibility.

Website and content owners should supply a CMS URL inventory and sitemap export, with locale, template and exclusion reason, plus source/rendered page bodies and authoritative claim references. Search owner should supply dated, attributed query/answer/citation observations per AI surface if visibility is in scope. Until then, account for readiness only and leave visibility unknown.

Search Console owner should export page/query Search Performance rows with property, dates, search type, filters and pagination, and separately supply scoped URL Inspection for /services with retrieval time, index status and Google-selected canonical. Bing Webmaster Tools owner should provide an attributable site search-performance export with site, date window, locale, market, timezone, surfaces and filters. Analytics owner should provide paginated GA4 landing-page and event report rows with property, query, date range, metrics, dimensions, timezone and currency. Separately provide GA4 property, streams and event/key-event definitions with scope and completeness, and a GTM container-version JSON with account/container, version and environment.

Business and product owners should confirm lead and booking success definitions, then export de-identified CRM and booking status records with UTC window, outcome dictionary, pseudonymous matching keys and failures. Implementation owner should provide existing approved test traces covering action, dataLayer, network and event timestamps with secrets and personal data removed. Privacy owner should supply the dated policy by region and intended default, update, revocation and tag behavior. Request separately attributed existing consent traces for those states and persistence.

Performance owner should provide CrUX URL or origin field exports with device, period and missingness, plus separate Lighthouse JSON runs with version, settings, URL, device and run conditions. Accessibility reviewer should provide axe output and criterion-linked manual keyboard, focus, form-error and recovery evidence with page, state, device/browser and timestamps. Product owner should attach existing journey evidence by step for lead and booking flows.
